scope: Remaining Times Square street fronts, W42–W49, Sixth–Eighth Avenues
geometry: Original NYC building triangles and OSM road/sidewalk centerlines remain unmodified. prepare-district.mjs ray-fits frontage finishes at four elevations and three horizontal positions, rejects existing landmark fronts, and validates sidewalk clearance.
visualReferences: User-provided Times Square and W42 photographs in this conversation
authoredDetails: Generic retail names, storefront finishes, advertisement selection, temporary scaffold placement and lamp shapes are reference-guided scenery, not a surveyed current reconstruction. No reference screenshot pixels or Google Maps data are embedded.
preservation: Previously customized landmark planes and existing general billboard planes are excluded from new frontage placement. Existing landmark modules, controls, buses, subway entrances and street widths remain intact.
performance: Static materials and shared atlas primitives, no per-frame facade work or dynamic lights. City buildings remain streamed 3D Tiles; only a bounded district detail layer is resident.
bryantParkLimitation: The requested 3 Bryant Park public plaza is documented by https://www.abbnyc.com/3-bryant-park-plaza and https://www.mdeas.com/the-cubes. The older NYC source contains a podium in the modern opening. This update does not remove that source geometry or claim to reproduce the full through-block plaza. It remains pending a compatible source correction or newer source mesh.
verificationLimit: Node physics, source-fit and real Cesium construction tests and production build. No browser WebGL image or measured live FPS verification in this environment.
